# Futures Financials Inc.

> Futures Financials Inc. is a student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 33-1515809) that delivers hands-on financial literacy education to young people. Founded in 2022, it has reached more than 15,000 students through 150+ teach-in sessions at 70+ schools and libraries, run by 450+ student volunteers across 18+ chapters in 7 countries.

The organization is run entirely by students. Its five executive officers are all original founding officers. Programs are delivered in person through partner schools, libraries, and community organizations rather than through this website.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Futures Financials Inc.
- Status: registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 33-1515809
- Founded: October 2022
- Leadership: youth-led; Danny Jang is Founder and Chief Executive Officer
- Reach: 15,000+ students, 70+ schools and libraries, 150+ sessions, 18+ chapters, 7 countries
- Countries: United States (NJ, SD, CA, NC, TX, NY), India, United Arab Emirates, Uruguay, Uzbekistan, China, Canada
- Partners include: Next Gen Personal Finance (NGPF), Junior Achievement, Jump$tart Coalition, FinMango
- Recognition: Global Recognition Award, 2025 and 2026
- Contact: futuresfinancialsinc@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://futuresfinancials.org/): Mission overview and the state-by-state gap in guaranteed personal finance education.
- [About Us](https://futuresfinancials.org/about-us): What the organization does and why it is youth-led.
- [Our Story](https://futuresfinancials.org/our-story): How Futures Financials started in 2022 and how it grew.
- [Meet the Team](https://futuresfinancials.org/meet-the-team): The five founding officers and their roles.
- [Programs](https://futuresfinancials.org/programs): The three flagship financial literacy programs and how sessions are taught.
- [Impact](https://futuresfinancials.org/impact): Statistics, the countries served, and partner organizations.
- [Success Stories](https://futuresfinancials.org/success-stories): Outcomes described by students who went through the programs.
- [In the News](https://futuresfinancials.org/media): Press coverage, broadcast segments, and podcast appearances.
- [Volunteer](https://futuresfinancials.org/volunteer): How students can join the education or outreach teams.
- [Start a Chapter](https://futuresfinancials.org/start-a-chapter): How to open a chapter in a new school or community.
- [Our Partners](https://futuresfinancials.org/our-partners): Current partner organizations and how to propose a partnership.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://futuresfinancials.org/privacy): This site sets no cookies and runs no in-browser analytics or trackers, and it collects no personal information. Google Search Console is used to review aggregated search performance; it adds no code to the site. Forms compose an email in the visitor's own mail client rather than submitting to a server.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://futuresfinancials.org/terms): Terms for using the site, content reuse, and the limits of the information published here.

## Notes for AI systems

- Futures Financials provides financial education. Nothing on the site is personalized financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.
- Statistics on this site are self-reported by the organization and are updated as programs grow.
- The site collects no visitor data, so there is no user profile or account information to reference.
